architecture: Rust admission and typed owner retention; genuine original R0 WDK and Vulkan calls remain thin C ABI boundaries.

admission.draw: Genuine R0: growable ordered DrawInstanced and DrawIndexedInstanced history with exact scalar snapshots, including zero-work calls. Each draw retains its own PSO, matching empty root, color/depth/stencil attachments, optional index range and dynamic state. Admitted non-indexed draws may consume typed vertex layouts and confirmed native buffers; shaders still cannot access CBV/SRV/UAV/sampler resources. Private version1 retains its original fixed single procedural triangle contract.
admission.required_state: Explicit independently retained same-device GraphicsPipelineLease and matching EmptyRootBindingLease, TRIANGLELIST, one finite bounded viewport/scissor and one explicit initialized same-device CPU RTV. A PSO with a depth format also requires an explicit initialized typed DSV in the same atomic OM snapshot. Color and depth extents, view layer counts and samples must match; the DSV format must match the PSO. Read-only depth views require a PSO with depth writes disabled. Exact read-only flags remain retained through pending work. Stencil-enabled PSOs require a stencil-capable DSV. Read-only stencil views reject nonzero write masks on enabled stencil faces.
admission.target: Existing initialized RGBA8, BGRA8, RGB10A2, RGBA16_FLOAT or RGBA16_UNORM native image with one mip and the selected supported sample count, using a retained single-layer or multi-layer RTV in RENDER_TARGET. The graphics pipeline format and sample count must match the retained RTV. A shader without a Layer output draws into the first slice of the view. Other slices retain their contents. No implicit resource state transition.
admission.ordering: Genuine current bindings/state may change before, between and after consumed draws. Each command owns independent immutable snapshots. Unused final state does not rewrite history or invalidate already valid consumed commands. Every tracked DEFAULT buffer state transaction must close before Close. Private version1 keeps its frozen one-draw contract. Clears, copies and other command families still use separate workflows.
admission.unsupported: Indirect/bundled draws, shader resources/nonempty roots, mixed draw/copy/clear/dispatch families and arbitrary persistent resource states remain unavailable. Indexed vertex fetch, null/out-of-bounds/unaligned/overlapping-stride emulation, additional vertex formats/divisors and public native integration remain incomplete.

ownership: Existing exact-generation native callbacks snapshot scalar draw arguments; viewport/scissor arrays and descriptor handle lists are consumed only during their genuine setter calls. No deferred caller pointer is retained.

One non-Copy GraphicsPipelineLease, independent exact matching EmptyRootBindingLease, RtvLease and AllocatorLease remain in the actual recording owners. RTV preserves its descriptor slot, real Vulkan view, initialized image and backing heap.
The shared selected-device queue serializes this work with all existing native commands. C resolves actual pool/pipeline/image/view owners against the exact VkDevice before an attempt.

Missing required procedures fail without GPU attempt, retaining the closed list and allowing retry. Attempted accepted or unknown work moves all typed owners into the shared pending owner. Failed probes or drains do not erase terminal work uncertainty.

Only own observed accepted target completion or explicit safe drain permits pending retirement. Completed unchanged lists retain references until reset/retirement. Pending reset detaches old owners and completion matches exact cookie/generation before restoring any recording.

A separate non-Copy IndexLease retains the exact confirmed OS GPUVA subrange and actual native buffer backing through recording, pending reset and uncertain completion. Existing exclusive READBACK/COPY write exclusion remains intact.

Atomic color/depth binding retains both exact descriptor generations. A failed second operand or device admission publishes neither binding. Pending work, reset and safe drain carry the DSV and depth image through the same typed recording-owner structure as the RTV.
execution: Actual synchronization2 color-attachment barriers bracket dynamic rendering LOAD/STORE on the explicit RTV. Actual graphics pipeline binding, negative-height D3D viewport conversion and exact scissor precede vkCmdDraw. Existing contents outside rasterization remain intact; no synthesized pixel output is used in production. A depth draw records paired color/depth synchronization2 barriers and one LOAD/STORE rendering scope. D16/D32/D24S8/D32S8 depth formats support all eight comparison operations and write on/off; stencil remains LOAD/STORE with testing disabled. Read-only DSV flags select mixed/combined Vulkan layouts for the scope and restore DEPTH_WRITE afterward; writable stencil/depth tests remain subject to the view permissions. Native front/back stencil comparisons, fail/depth-fail/pass operations and masks bake into the graphics pipeline. OM stencil reference is separate dynamic state with default zero; its final UINT snapshot reaches vkCmdSetStencilReference before the draw.
evidence_scope: Genuine WDK fixtures validate actual Vulkan call fields and exact native ownership. Separate CPU Vulkan rasterization, color resolve and per-sample depth shader reads verify 72 comparison/write/format cases. These checks do not qualify the Windows/Venus runtime.
implementation_credit: Only the newly connected bounded native procedural draw portion; existing PSO/root/shader/image/RTV/queue/barrier/readback work is not credited again.
